context: Riku tells Aoi about a surprising school day.
purpose: Casual register; vocabulary (驚い/中学/それに/食べ物/ちゃい) in natural home.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 中学の給食、急に変わって驚いたよ。
lines.en: The middle-school lunch suddenly changed; I was surprised.
lines.style: animated teen boy voice, bright warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: へえ、どんな食べ物になったの?
lines.en: Oh, what kind of food did it become?
lines.style: curious barista voice, soft warm cheerful delivery throughout

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 世界の食べ物が、出るようになったんだ。
lines.style: enthusiastic teen boy voice, bright warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: それに、味はどうだったの?
lines.style: engaged barista voice, soft warm cheerful delivery throughout

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: それに、すごくおいしくて驚いたよ。
lines.en: And it was so good it surprised me.
lines.style: delighted teen boy voice, bright warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 苦手な食べ物は、困らなかった?
lines.en: Didn't disliked foods give you trouble?
lines.style: curious barista voice, soft warm cheerful delivery throughout

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 辛いのは、ちょっと困ったけどね。
lines.en: The spicy stuff was a bit of a problem.
lines.style: rueful teen boy voice, bright warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 中学の給食、進化してるね!
lines.style: bubbly barista voice, soft warm closing delivery throughout
